title: SWE-Dev (THUDM)
input: Repository task descriptions, patches and execution environments.
native_output: Generated behavior descriptions and executable tests.

conversion.approach: Attach its generated verifier to the source task in a separately labeled export copy.

known_limitations: This is verifier generation, not a new learner-writes-tests pipeline.

why_this_order: Reproduce test construction on 100 existing task inputs after a repository baseline exists.
